intro: Lesson 26. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ (١٧) فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ (١٨) وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ (١٩) فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلْءَايَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ (٢٠) فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ (٢١) ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ (٢٢) فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ (٢٣) فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ (٢٤)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: "Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.
And say to him, 'Would you [be willing to] purify yourself
And let me guide you to your Lord so you would fear [Him]?'"
And he showed him the greatest sign,
Then he turned his back, striving.
And he gathered [his people] and called out
And said, "I am your most exalted lord."

questions.q: Chunk and link An-Nazi'at 79:17-24 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 79:17-24 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 79:17-24 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: List Pharaoh's four actions in 79:21 to 23.
questions.a: He denied, disobeyed, turned his back striving, gathered his people and called out.
A) 'I am your most exalted lord'. 79:24: 'And said, "I am your most exalted lord."'

questions.q: Think again: Allah sent Musa to Pharaoh with gentle words: 'Would you purify yourself?' (79:18). Why speak gently even to a tyrant?
questions.a: Gentle words open hearts; the aim is guidance, not winning an argument.
